Android 10+ · No root required

Control, optimize, and manage your Android from one focused app.

ADBTweaks brings ADB-powered system controls, gaming profiles, app management, optimization tools, debloating, device monitoring, and a built-in terminal into one Android app.

Download on Google Play Explore features
No root required Clear controls & restore options Local device operations
ADBTweaks — session example
$ cmd game list-modes com.example.game ✓ Game modes detected standard · performance · custom $ cmd game set --downscale 0.85 --fps 120 com.example.game ✓ Custom profile configured scale=0.85 · fps=120 $ cmd game mode custom com.example.game ✓ Custom game mode active

The tools you actually need

ADB-powered controls for Android system settings, games, apps, optimization, and everyday device management.

ADB terminal

Run ADB shell commands with a built-in terminal and session management.

System tweaks

Adjust supported Android settings with concise explanations and restore controls.

Game profiles

Create per-game profiles for supported game modes, FPS, and resolution scaling.

App optimization

Run supported app optimization and ART compilation tasks for selected apps.

Debloat

Find common unwanted packages and manage supported apps for the current user.

Monitor & diagnostics

View useful device information such as memory, storage, temperature, and refresh rate.

Built with clear limits

ADB operations remain focused on the connected device, while Android and manufacturer restrictions still apply.

Local device operations

Core device operations use ADB or supported wireless debugging interfaces. Optional website services are separate.

Clear restore controls

Supported tweaks provide restore controls where the underlying Android setting can be restored.

No account for core use

Core app features do not require an account. See the Privacy Policy for website and optional services.

Device-dependent features

Some controls depend on Android version, device hardware, OEM firmware, or available permissions.
